macos.notes: macOS 26.5.2 arm64 proves production child creation, readiness, fresh 2x bounds, policy-admitted retained navigation without reload or recreation, hide/show reuse, renderer-unmount independence, focus request, browser-policy injection, close, replacement, teardown, host destruction, generation retirement, and capability isolation. Portable visibility and focus readback remain unknown. The one-monitor host exposed only 2x scale, so live scale switching remains unmet and unsimulated.

windows.notes: No Windows packaged host was available. WebView2 child construction, bounds, focus, visibility, callback ordering, and teardown remain unproved.

linux.notes: No Linux packaged host was available. WebKitGTK child construction, bounds, focus, visibility, callback ordering, and teardown remain unproved. macOS data-store identity is rejected on this target.
